title: At the coffeehouse
goal: Make offers, requests and promises with the aorist, and talk about habits: Çay içer misiniz? Yarın ararım.

intro.text: The aorist also makes offers and polite requests: *Çay içer misiniz?* (Would you like some tea?), *Bakar mısınız?* (Excuse me!). And it makes promises on the spot: *Yarın ararım* (I'll call tomorrow). Say yes with *Olur* (OK, sure).

vocab.en: Excuse me! (to call a waiter or a shop assistant)
What do you think? How about it?

exercises.question: In a café, you want the waiter to come over. What do you say?

why.1: *Bakıyor musunuz?* asks what someone is doing now: **are you looking?**
why.2: *Baktınız mı?* is the past: **did you look?**

exercises.explain: *Bakar mısınız?*, literally **will you look?**, is the polite way to call a waiter or a shop assistant.

accept: Would you like to drink (some) tea?

exercises.en: Don't worry, I'll call you tomorrow.

reject.why: The last vowel of *ara-* is a, a back vowel: *ararım*.

exercises.explain: A promise made on the spot takes the aorist: *ararım*. *Arayacağım* is also right: it states the plan.

reject.why: *Açıyor musun?* asks whether you **are opening** it. For a request, use the aorist: *açar mısın?*

exercises.tr: Dedem her akşam kahvehanede tavla oynar.
exercises.en: My grandfather plays backgammon at the coffeehouse every evening.

exercises.question: What does Can say about backgammon?

context.tr: Ben de. Bir de tavla getirir misiniz?
context.en: Me too. And could you bring us a backgammon board?
Of course, I'll bring one right away.

context.tr: Can, sen sık sık tavla oynar mısın?
context.en: Can, do you often play backgammon?

context.tr: Her hafta oynarım. Ama hep kaybederim!
context.en: Every week. But I always lose!

context.tr: Ne dersin, bir el oynar mısın?
context.en: What do you say, will you play a round?

options: He plays every week and always loses.
He plays every week and always wins.
exercises.explain: *Her hafta oynarım* (I play every week), *hep kaybederim* (I always lose): habits, so the aorist.

exercises.prompt: My grandfather never loses at backgammon.

exercises.text: Bu akşam bize gelir misin? — ___, saat yedide gelirim.
exercises.en: Will you come over this evening? — Sure, I'll come at seven.
exercises.explain: *Olur* (OK, sure) agrees; *Olmaz* refuses; *Bilmem* means **I don't know**.

exercises.label: *demek* (to say) in the aorist: I say, you say…
exercises.explain: *De-* ends in a vowel: `-r`, and the e stays: *der*, not *dir*. *Ne dersin?* means **What do you think?**

accept: Everyone drinks tea at the coffeehouse.
Everyone drinks tea [in the coffeehouse|at the coffee house|in the coffee house].
